jobs.description:

For our client, we are looking for a motivated INDUSTRIAL CLEANER.

• Assisting with filling the tunnels

jobs.occupation: Customer Service & Customs Coordinator | West-Flanders Area
jobs.description:
Our client is a long-established industrial manufacturer with production sites in Belgium and abroad, supplying high-performance chemical solutions. Supported by private equity investors, the organisation is evolving from a traditional setup towards a more modern, performance-driven operating model. The company is located in the North of the province of West Flanders.

Jobomschrijving

The Customer Service & Customs Coordinator will:

• Become a key member of a team of five customer service professionals, managing the complete order-to-cash process for an international B2B customer portfolio.
• Oversee and manage customs documentation and trade compliance activities for international import and export transactions.
• Act as the primary point of contact for customers, building strong relationships and ensuring an excellent service experience from order placement through delivery and invoicing.
• Proactively manage customer enquiries, orders, delivery follow-up, and issue resolution, ensuring customer satisfaction and operational excellence.
• Coordinate closely with planning, logistics, production, and sales teams to ensure seamless execution of customer commitments.
• Collaborate with freight forwarders and customs brokers to facilitate smooth and compliant cross-border shipments.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and digital transformation projects, helping modernise processes and enhance customer service efficiency.

The Customer Service & Customs Coordinator we are looking for has:

• At least 3 years of experience in customer service, order management, logistics coordination and/or customs within an international B2B environment.
• A genuine customer-centric mindset and the ability to build strong relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders.
• Experience working with ERP systems (SAP is a strong asset).
• Knowledge of customs processes and international trade compliance requirements.
• Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Fluency in Dutch and English; French and/or German are considered an advantage.
• The flexibility and adaptability to thrive in a changing environment and support process improvements.

jobs.occupation: Head of Sales - Regulated B2B Services
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international service provider operating across multiple countries in Europe and beyond. • Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Belgian market.
• Translate business objectives into clear action plans and measurable KPIs.

• Support the team in managing complex sales cycles and strategic accounts.
• Ensure effective collaboration across departments.
Key Account Management

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with major national customers.
• Manage executive-level conversations with key decision-makers.
• Lead commercial negotiations and contract discussions.
• Act as a trusted partner for strategic clients and stakeholders.
Marketing Coordination

• Coordinate local marketing initiatives in collaboration with international colleagues.
• Manage relationships with external marketing partners and agencies.
• Support brand visibility, customer engagement and commercial campaigns.
• Contribute to market positioning and business growth initiatives.

What matters most is your ability to lead teams, build commercial strategies and drive business results in a B2B environment.You bring:

• A proven track record in a B2B commercial leadership role.
• Experience managing and developing sales teams.
• Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking skills.
• Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities.
• Experience working with large accounts and complex customer environments.
• The ability to build structure, set priorities and drive execution.
• A hands-on mindset combined with strong leadership qualities.
• Curiosity and the willingness to learn and understand a new industry.
• Fluency in Dutch, French, English

The company is a leading international player operating in a highly customer-centric and relationship-driven industry.In Belgium, it works closely with an extensive network of professional partners, providing innovative solutions, commercial support and expert guidance to help them grow their business.Backed by a strong culture of innovation and continuous improvement, the company is recognized for its commitment to customer excellence, people development and sustainable growth.
